title: getloginpagewithoutauthentication
description: Verify that accessing GET /login returns the login page without requiring authentication.

title: getinventorywithauthentication
description: Verify that accessing GET /inventory with a valid authenticated session returns the inventory page with the user's product records.

title: getinventorywithoutauthentication
description: Verify that accessing GET /inventory without authentication returns an authorization error or access denial.

title: getbackuprestorewithauthentication
description: Verify that accessing GET /backup-restore with a valid authenticated session returns the backup and restore interface and initiates data synchronization.

title: getbackuprestorewithoutauthentication
description: Verify that accessing GET /backup-restore without authentication returns an authorization error and does not start synchronization.
